messages:
Jess: did anyone else see that last-second OT buzzer-beater?? 😳 final was 112-110, absolute chaos. who wins the office pool??
Omar: I had the under and lost my dignity. rip my lineup. :sob: Riley owes me a beer if my captain hit that shot lol
Liu: that ending was wild. also the fantasy points swing killed me — dropped 24 pts in the last 2 mins. can we please have a rule: no more live waiver claims during OT? :joy:
scorebot: GAME UPDATE: Final 112-110. Winning shot with 0.4s left. Box: https://scores.example.com/game/18321 (threaded summary)
Jess: ok practical thing — pizza for watch party on Friday? winners get first slice and pool payout in gift cards. vote: pepperoni / veggie / mix / no pizza
Riley: pepperoni +1. also can someone Venmo the pool? I can collect and do gift cards.
Omar: mix please, and count me in for Venmo. how much are we doing for the pool? $5? $10?
Jess: thinking $10 this week, $5 feels too tiny for buzzer-beaters. :money_mouth_face:
Liu: $10 works. Jessie, put a quick order poll and I'll throw in toppings.
Jess: created poll: https://polls.example.com/p/1832109876 — vote by Thursday noon. If pepperoni wins, Riley is on pizza duty :pizza:
Riley: guilty. I accept pizza duty if I get bragging rights and one guaranteed overtime slice. :raised_hands:
Omar: deal. also can we make a tiny rule change: if your fantasy captain scores last-second winner you get +1 tiebreaker point for next week? :thinking_face:
Liu: love that. meta suggestion: next week someone should stream and we do live commentary + snack bets. low effort fun.
Jess: adding to the feed. congrats to the winner(s) — also still salty about my lineup tho. good game everyone :clap:
